preconditions.description: Number of vertices V is between 1 and 10000.
Number of edges E is between 0 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u < V and 0 <= v < V and 1 <= w <= 99 for u, v, w in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (u, v, w) has valid vertex indices and weight.
Source vertex s and destination vertex t are valid.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of different shortest paths from s to t.
